title: Jharkhand Home Guard Corps Recruitment 2026 – Home Guard (Grih Rakshak) Posts
shortInfo: Jharkhand Home Guard Corps has announced notification for Home Guard (Grih Rakshak) posts. Required qualification: 7th Pass, 10th Pass. Last date to apply: 26-10-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in
Fill in the online application form with all required details.
Upload a recent colour photograph and signature.
Upload self-attested copies of required certificates (residential, educational, age, caste, sports, technical qualification as applicable).
Provide details of Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Driving Licence / PAN Card (Aadhaar preferred).
Pay the application fee of Rs. 100/- through the Online Payment Gateway on the website.
Submit the application form only after successful payment of the fee.
Only one application per applicant is accepted; an applicant can apply for only one block/urban area.

title: Jharkhand High Court Recruitment 2026 – Law Researcher, Research Associate Posts
shortInfo: Jharkhand High Court has announced notification for Law Researcher, Research Associate posts. Required qualification: Fresh Law Graduate, Post Graduate. Last date to apply: 28-09-26.
howToApply: Download the application form from the Official Website of High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi: www.jharkhandhighcourt.nic.in/recruitment.
Fill up the application form in the prescribed format.
Prepare a single PDF file (not exceeding 10 MB) containing the scanned copy of the filled application form along with scanned copies of all required enclosures.
Submit the PDF file via email to rgjhc.jhr@gmail.com between 07.09.2026 and 28.09.2026 only.

Enclosures to be submitted: (i) Matriculation Certificate as proof of date of birth; (ii) Marksheets of all semesters/years of Law Graduation and Post Graduation (if applicable); (iii) Provisional/Original degree Certificate of Law Graduation and Post Graduation (if applicable); (iv) Recommendation by a designated Senior Advocate or Head of the last Law School/College/University attended; (v) Computer certificate, if any.
Candidates are advised to keep a printout of the duly filled application form for future reference. No physical copy needs to be sent to the High Court.

title: DVC Recruitment 2026 – Overman Posts
shortInfo: DVC has announced notification for Overman posts. Required qualification: Diploma in Mining Engineering, Overman's Certificate, First Aid Certificate. Last date to apply: 21-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the DVC website: www.dvc.gov.in → Careers → Recruitment → Recruitment Notices.
Click on the ‘APPLY ONLINE’ link available under the relevant recruitment notice.
Step 1: Fill in all the particulars in the Online Application Form.
Step 2: Upload scanned photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, PNG/JPG/JPEG, max 2MB), signature, Class Xth/XIIth/Diploma/Overman Certificate or marksheet, and essential qualification certificates.
Step 3: Preview the application form and edit/update data if required.
Step 4: Submit the application. Once submitted, the application cannot be edited.
After successful submission, a Unique Application Number will be generated. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
Keep the printout of the Online Application Form safely for future reference.
Online registration is active from 03/09/2026 to 21/09/2026 (till 23:59 hrs).

howToApply: Visit the official JSSC website: https://jssc.jharkhand.gov.in/
Click on “Online Application for JTAACCE-2026 (Para Teacher)” and complete registration.
Note down the registration number and password sent via SMS/email.

Log in again and fill in complete personal, educational, and category details; save and continue through each page. Select whether you are applying for the regular vacancy (04/2026), backlog vacancy (05/2026), or both.
Pay the exam fee online after logging in again the next day (post 12:00 noon). Only one fee is payable even if applying for both advertisements.
One day after fee payment, log in again to upload your scanned photograph and signature.
Verify all details, submit the form, and take a printout for future reference.
